source.title: Partner 360 — Automated Manufacturer Catalog Completion & Launch
source.body:
## Owner direction — 2026-10-23
Accelerate completion of HCPS Partner 360 dealer ordering across every represented non-Golden manufacturer. Reuse the existing storefront and product-detail templates; eliminate one-manufacturer-at-a-time manual entry. Golden retains its separate ordering portal. Owner wants progress through normal engineering work without repetitive approval requests, with safeguards on commercial accuracy and production release.

## Grounded starting point (read-only repository + Supabase inspection, 2026-10-23)
Repo: angeloaudia1975/homecareproviderservicesordering, main.
Live HCPS Ordering Supabase database has **several catalog layers**: `public/data/<manufacturer>.json`, `custom_products`, `product_overrides`, `product_images`, `product_content`, and the newer master commercial `product_skus`. `price_imports` are immutable source rows; `reconcile_conflicts` records unresolved differences. Do not assume README Phase 1 is current.

Master `product_skus` active SKU count / approved content pages:
- ovation-medical: 303 / 60 (preserve existing verified work)
- climbing-steps: 21 / 21 (preserve)
- strongback-mobility: 14 / 14 (preserve)
- bemis: 9 / 3 of 7 (finalize)
- access4u, airavant-bongorx, corsicana, pedifix, ohio-medical/gce, dalton, abm-respiratory-care: no master SKU rows currently observed, but many have legacy catalog data and must NOT be called empty/absent.
- Important key discrepancy: `public/data/manufacturers.json` uses `gce` while DB metadata/legacy overrides also use `ohio-medical`. Plan explicit normalization rather than silently split or merge.

These database counts are not proof of live dealer-visible behavior. Verify the deployed environment and correct branch/config.

## Objective
One repeatable, source-attributed pipeline to research, import, reconcile, enrich, QA and stage/publish all represented lines, not bespoke manual editing of product cards. Output a dealer-ready marketplace with correct entitled pricing, categories, dimensions/options, images, descriptions, MAP/MSRP only where documented, freight, PO/order confirmation, manufacturer email routing, and mobile experience.

## Workstreams — proceed in parallel where independent

**A. Inventory and truth hierarchy**
1. Read code paths and database schema and produce an up-to-date per-manufacturer inventory: source docs/dates, JSON rows, legacy rows, SKU master rows, live effective selling SKUs, content pages, image coverage, missing pricing, conflicts, current visibility flags, checkout enablement and active/deactivated models.
2. Establish stable manufacturer slug + exact SKU + explicit variant mapping. Identify canonical catalog definitions: commercial price/tiers/UOM/status from `product_skus`; marketing content/specs/categories/media from approved content/category maps; retain import source + effective date. Never repurpose SKU codes or overwrite approved records on guesses.
3. Identify legacy/modern layers that disagree. Emit a machine-readable diff and owner exception report. No silent wholesale migration or destructive cleanup.
4. Produce an accurate go-live matrix and a progress dashboard that distinguishes *existing in JSON*, *master migrated*, *enriched*, *dealer-visible*, and *order-verified*.

**B. Reusable bulk importer and enrichment**
1. Build generic manufacturer adapters for pricing XLSX/CSV/PDF and websites/authorized catalogs; reusable parsing, normalized CSV/JSON review artifacts, deduplication, validation and idempotent upsert staging. Import to a review state with provenance; publish only verified commercial facts.
2. Research manufacturer official pages, authorized assets and (only as corroboration) reseller pages. Capture source URL, checked date, SKU/variant match and confidence, along with an exception list. Never invent descriptions, images, MSRP/MAP, freight, HCPCS, weights, UOM, pack sizes, availability or lead times.
3. Image pipeline: prefer authorized manufacturer imagery; locate exact model/variant, download/rehost only when authorized, preserve ratios, make thumbnails and fallbacks, detect dead URLs and wrong variants; create unresolved-image report rather than labeling unmatched images as verified.
4. Add taxonomy crosswalk by manufacturer: category/subcategory/product family, variations (size/color/laterality), related accessories; don't multiply duplicate product pages or mix legacy SKUs with options.
5. Keep products without verified dealer pricing unavailable for purchase; do not display invented/legacy prices as authoritative. Do not derive MSRP using a universal multiplier. Verify manufacturer-specific contracts and case/quantity tiers.

**C. Manufacturer batches**
- Batch 0: protect verified Ovation, Climbing Steps, Strongback as golden test fixtures; regress all three.
- Batch 1: finish BEMIS first: remaining approved pages, SKU/case packs and freight; verify source terms for free freight >= $500, $40 below, $20 dropship, less-than-case $10 per line rather than assuming all captured in cart rules.
- Batch 2 parallel: AIRAVANT/BongoRx, Access4U, PediFix, Ohio Medical/GCE, Corsicana, ABM. Use existing legacy content and latest authoritative supplier lists. Get a source-gap checklist for commercial facts requiring owner's documents.
- Batch 3 Dalton Medical (existing dedicated 2026 price/catalog work must be reconciled; do not silently apply an old 5% discount; verify lead times and special bed preorder state with current source).
- Reconcile manufacturer's active line roster with HCPS before claiming 100% coverage. Golden out of this project.

**D. Storefront and order acceptance**
For each manufacturer, automated smoke tests: dealer auth/entitlement & RLS, anonymous price leakage, real authorized dealer view, category navigation, search, correct image and variant, price/tier/case and per-line freight logic, mixed manufacturer cart, separate PO/order records and appropriately formatted manufacturer emails, taxes if applicable, validation, mobile usability, confirmation and My Orders totals. Use staging and non-deliverable test orders; do not send live commercial orders to a manufacturer during testing. Confirm price displayed = charged/emailed/stored. Snapshot and rollback migration plan.

**E. Engineering delivery and approvals**
- First deliver audit/report + implementation design; then build independent branches/PRs for shared importer, per-manufacturer adapters and QA.
- Test against a safely isolated/staged environment; guard live settings, retain backups, avoid changing production pricing/active flags/permissions or sending real emails until checks pass and the exact release is approved.
- Noncommercial formatting/content improvements can proceed through normal PR review. Require documented authority for any material dealer price, freight, UOM, clinical/regulatory statement, discontinuation or availability change.
- Do not expose Supabase service keys or private wholesale terms in public static JSON, page source or unauthenticated APIs.
- For each PR record test results, imported and published counts, missing pricing/media, price-source date, rollback steps, and owner-only exceptions.
- Keep scope focused on ordering/catalog launch; no independent redesign of Dealer 360, Academy or Golden order portal.

## Definition of done per manufacturer
(1) All currently sellable official SKUs accounted for or documented exceptions; (2) verified dealer pricing and per-SKU unit/case/tier rules; (3) categories and variants mapped; (4) media and descriptions reasonably complete with no incorrect stand-ins; (5) entitlement and approval gates secure; (6) totals/freight/order email consistent; (7) mobile and checkout tests pass in staging; (8) owner-facing sign-off summary with source dates and outstanding exceptions.

## Immediate first deliverables
1. Baseline live-vs-repository inventory & go-live coverage matrix.
2. Shared importer + image matching/rehosting architecture proposal, aligned to existing admin/catalog workspace and current authority flags.
3. First BEMIS completion PR plus parallel source-gap research for remaining manufacturers; keep production unchanged until verified.
4. Short owner-request list ONLY for irreplaceable source documents/permissions or business-policy conflicts (not manual row-by-row entry).

Please use this issue as the implementation umbrella; report per-workstream PR links and concrete completion evidence.

## Cross-repository handoff + protected BEMIS correction (2026-10-23)
This umbrella launch issue MUST coordinate **two repositories**:
- `angeloaudia1975/homecareproviderservices`: Manufacturer Center implementation, release/approval/correction workflow, and related Netlify functions (e.g. `src/admin/manufacturer-center.html`, `netlify/functions/_publish.js`, `CLAUDE.md`).
- `angeloaudia1975/homecareproviderservicesordering`: Partner 360 dealer-facing storefront, orders/cart, and catalog feed.
Do not assume that completing a change in one repo changes the other or that the original umbrella issue describes both codebases completely. Check the current `CLAUDE.md` in both repos before editing.

**Owner-provided prior Claude handoff:** BEMIS current finalized Gold Standard PASS is run #20, and earlier failed runs #16–#19 must remain in immutable history; UI fixes were described as deployed and need fresh production verification. BEMIS Assurance published-page regression correction was PREPARED ONLY. The proposed dry-run plan hash begins `0da21cc8b2b854a3`. The correction is strictly one product page `assurance-raised-toilet-seat-with-clean-shield-3-in` and strictly 3 fields, keeping all photos, options, grouping, other pages, documents/videos, price, tiers, UOM, MAP/MSRP, freight, and status unchanged.

**Independently confirmed live Supabase DB as of 2026-10-23:** `mfr_decisions` #908 regression_fix and #909 description / #910 features / #911 specs approvals all exist and `used_at IS NULL`; Assurance `product_content` still contains the undesired 1,000 lb capacity and Stay·Tite wording. Latest `mfr_verification_runs` for Bemis is run #20 PASS (2026-10-13 UTC). No post-correction publication can be claimed yet.

**Safety gate:** Owner's explicit earlier instruction was **do not publish/finalize Assurance correction until the dry run is approved**. Preserve this and revalidate plan hash / fingerprint and exact scope before seeking explicit approval. Do not bypass with enrichment window #907, do not destroy historical runs, and do not re-enrich or mutate already approved lines as a side effect of bulk importer work.

**Immediate coordinated task:** verify the main HCPS Manufacturer Center fix/code deployment, keep Bemis correction review separate, and build/readiness-audit other manufacturer adapters in parallel without publishing or rewriting frozen lines. Report distinct status: current Gold Standard / historical verification failures / staging / approved / published. Require dry-run matching plan hash and explicit release authorization for any production correction.

**PR:** angeloaudia1975/homecareproviderservices#34 — launch-readiness matrix (read-only; no dealer-facing change; no production writes). Tests: readiness 34/34, mutants 31/31 killed, snapshot pg 5/5, Manufacturer Center pg suites 81/81, correction 13/13 + 16/16 mutants.

## 2026-10-23 integration checkpoint — owner-directed Complete Medical retirement and P0 security
Current pending change pairs:
- **Remove Complete Medical**: ordering PR #4, admin PR #37. Owner's intent: not an HCPS represented line; keep historical orders/commissions/dealer associations.
- **P0 commercial privacy**: ordering PR #3, admin PR #36. MUST deploy together with private DB overlay and price parity.
- **Readiness** admin PR #34; **Importer** admin PR #35; other content/staging PR in progress.

Independent ChatGPT connector review comments now exist on #4 and #37 (plus earlier #3/#36/#34/#35). Outstanding integration blockers:
1. P0 seed script enumerates pre-retirement Complete Medical from git ref 4b1bad3; if PR #4 removes its JSON, future private overlay seed flags a mismatch. Explicitly remove retired line from seeding, overlay row counts, and test cross-branch merge/rebase. Never reintroduce its 473 catalog rows or prices.
2. PR #4 README references executing `supabase/retire_complete_medical.sql`, but PR #37 CLAUDE.md explicitly says do NOT run that script because it deletes historical dealer_manufacturers records. Correct docs; no retirement SQL should run.
3. PR #37 `_pricing.js` fallback permits any line when manufacturer list is empty/404. Fail closed in the production caller and test empty/missing list with residual custom_products; preserve compatibility only where explicitly intended.
4. Both #37 and #36 edit server _pricing.js; both #4 and #3 edit same shop catalog. Rebase and run an integrated test matrix on exact combined heads (not independent CI only), including protected Gold Standard lines and dealer checkout.
5. Do not deploy live P0 until overlay identity/version guard proven, DB seed exact, admin before storefront, legacy access lock only after test dealer passes, old Netlify deploys considered, and independent review/release gate satisfied.

Catalog content/importer work can continue in parallel. BEMIS #908–#911 correction remains separately held. Current storefront/admin production unchanged by this comment.

## Owner direction — ONE final checklist, not piecemeal approvals (2026-10-23)
The owner requests a single consolidated, executable owner-action/go-live checklist once development and integration have progressed as far as possible without owner-only inputs. **Do not stop routine engineering, reviews, safe draft staging and tests to request one manufacturer date, one SKU confirmation, one setting or one approval at a time.** Keep a living internal action/dependency register with evidence and links; resolve developer-owned items independently; group all remaining legitimate owner actions into ONE final handoff, in dependency order.

The final checklist should specify exactly what the owner must do (link/page/button, document to supply, confirmation, expected PASS evidence), estimated scope, priority, prerequisites, and which decisions are optional. Consolidate Netlify historic-preview and production permalink protection, GitHub repo privacy, Supabase private pricing migration + verified seed/rollback, coordinated admin/storefront release + signed-in tests, dealer entitlements, commercial source receipts and unresolved terms, product claims, image rights, frozen-line Gold Standard checks, and BEMIS's separate correction gate. Distinguish *developer-ready* from *dealer-launch-ready*. Do not invent missing prices/dates or quietly approve publication.

**Exception:** Escalate an active high-severity security incident, irreversible/destructive operation, legal compliance blocker or immediate risk that cannot safely wait; do not defer vital warnings just to achieve a single checklist.

The owner prefers large engineering batches and a single consolidated handoff, not repeated 'please do this small action' requests.
